CI compiles Windows, Linux and macOS packages and packs the project’s own spaghetti.o2r; no ROM-based test, matching check or gameplay comparison is published. The FAQ records limits such as eight racers and eight selectable characters, limited HD texture support and no online play. This collection did not build or run the port.

The reviewed tree has no top-level license file, so reuse terms for the project’s code are unstated; libultraship and Torch declare MIT, and Nintendo content retains separate rights. The reviewed sources establish no AI or REA attribution, and no runtime reproduction is claimed.

name: Animal Crossing: Wild World: matching Korean DS decompilation with differential runtime checks
description_en: Reconstructs the ARM9 game code of Animal Crossing: Wild World’s Korean DS release as one C or C++ source per function, checked against the user’s ROM with the original Metrowerks compiler and linker. Each function also has a readable Clean rewrite, and an included DS interpreter compares the ROM code, natively compiled sources and rewrites on recorded play. Data sections, the ARM7 binary, the linked SDK libraries and regrouping into original source files remain outside the reconstruction.
description_zh: 将 Animal Crossing: Wild World 韩版 DS 游戏的 ARM9 游戏代码重建为每个函数一个 C 或 C++ 源文件，并用原版 Metrowerks 编译器和链接器对照使用者自己的 ROM 校验。每个函数另有可读的 Clean 改写版本，仓库自带的 DS 解释器在录制的游玩过程中比较 ROM 代码、原生编译的源码和改写版本。数据段、ARM7 程序、链接的 SDK 库及按原始源文件重新归组仍不在重建范围内。
requirements: Covers only the Korean release (ADMK) ARM9 code. The verification page, dated 2026-10-18, reports all 25,247 game functions passing byte and relocation checks, 24,767 linked with mwldarm into modules that match the ROM, and 17 marked FAKEMATCH. Data sections mostly still come from the ROM through ds-decomp objects; the ARM7 binary, .bss pointers and source-file regrouping are not covered, and most names are placeholders.

Requires the user’s own Korean ROM matching SHA-1 1fffd601d3439e37cd934e72d08e487a93fc449b and the Metrowerks CodeWarrior for DS compiler (mwccarm); neither is distributed. NitroSDK, NitroSystem, NitroDWC with the GameSpy SDK, NitroWiFi and the Metrowerks runtime (4,083 functions) are excluded, and the tools count them as not decompiled when absent.

Python 3.11+ drives extraction, verification and linking, and ds-decomp’s dsd v0.12.1 performs the whole-program link and module comparison. Linux and macOS run the Windows compiler through wibo. The PC runtime builds as a 32-bit program with clang on Windows or gcc on Linux.

CI runs in a private container that holds the ROM and compiler. runtime.md reports Reference, Native and Clean runs agreeing on a 1,300-frame title recording, a 13,760-frame new-game recording and eight scenes from a save that is not in the repository, while three scenes still differ. The GitHub Actions build for the reviewed commit passed verification, linking and the Native checks but failed its Clean-function differential check. This review ran none of these checks.

The repository is dedicated under CC0 1.0 and states that it is not affiliated with Nintendo. The ROM, compiler, SDK libraries and test save keep their own rights. The reviewed sources state no AI or REA involvement, and no runtime reproduction is claimed.

name: King Kong Recompiled: an AI-developed Xbox 360 static recompilation
description_en: Translates the Xbox 360 release of Peter Jackson's King Kong into native Windows code with the ReXGlue static-recompilation SDK, adding a launcher and display, control and graphics options. Project code completes streamed disc reads the way the console does, which README credits with getting past an opening freeze seen under Xenia. The author discloses that the port was made almost entirely with Claude Code, directed and tested by the repository owner.
description_zh: 借助 ReXGlue 静态重编译 SDK，将 Xbox 360 版 Peter Jackson's King Kong 转译为原生 Windows 代码，并加入启动器以及显示、操控和图形选项。项目代码按主机的方式完成流式光盘读取；README 称这使游戏越过了在 Xenia 中出现的开场卡死。作者披露，该移植几乎完全由 Claude Code 完成，仓库所有者负责指导和测试。
requirements: README and .recomp.json describe a static recompilation of the USA/Europe Xbox 360 disc (title ID 555307D3, version 0.0.0.1) with ReXGlue, which credits Xenia and XenonRecomp. Release v1.9.11 ships only a Windows x64 package; Linux and Steam Deck run it through Proton experimentally, while a native Linux build and a native Vulkan/DirectX 12 renderer are described as in progress. README says a full play-through has not been confirmed.

Requires a full disc image made from the player's own copy of that release; README gives its expected size and SHA-1, and the launcher checks the title ID before copying about 6.3 GB of game files next to the program. No game files are included, and the recompiled C++ derived from the game's code is regenerated locally and excluded from the repository.

Playing needs 64-bit Windows 10 or 11, a DirectX 12 graphics card and about 7 GB of space. Source builds need Visual Studio 2022 Build Tools with Clang, CMake and Ninja; setup.ps1 downloads ReXGlue SDK 0.10.0 and generates the recompiled sources from the player's disc image before kk/build.bat compiles them.

Reported checks are the owner's testing and developer autoplay builds that also collect shader packs; the reviewed tree has no CI workflow. Known issues include wrong character animations above 30 fps and periodic pauses in pre-rendered videos. The launcher's anonymous online-player check-in is on by default. This collection did not build or run the port.

No license file is present, so reuse terms for the port's code are unstated; the bundled upscaler notices are MIT, and ReXGlue and other dependencies keep their own terms. Game code, assets and trademarks remain their owners', and the project disclaims affiliation with Ubisoft, Universal, Microsoft and others. The AI disclosure names Claude Code, not REA, so this is not an REA case.

name: ReVa (Reverse Engineering Assistant)
description_en: Ghidra extension that runs an MCP server inside Ghidra, giving agents decompilation with namespace and cross-reference context, symbol, string, data-type, structure and call-graph tools, program diffing, renaming and PyGhidra scripting. Its README attributes the project's distinction to tool design for LLM use: many small tools whose schemas tolerate other input, redirect correctable mistakes and return short fragments linked to related information. Assistant mode serves an open Ghidra project to several clients at once; headless mode starts Ghidra itself with session-scoped projects.
description_zh: 在 Ghidra 内运行 MCP 服务器的 Ghidra 扩展，为智能体提供附带命名空间与交叉引用上下文的反编译、符号、字符串、数据类型、结构体与调用图工具，以及程序比对、重命名和 PyGhidra 脚本执行。其 README 将项目的特点归于面向大模型使用的工具设计：提供许多小工具，其模式在给定结构之外也能容忍其他输入，把可纠正的错误反馈给模型，并返回附带相关信息链接的简短片段。助手模式可让多个客户端同时连接已打开的 Ghidra 项目；无界面模式则由 ReVa 自行启动 Ghidra，项目仅在会话期间存在。
requirements: Ghidra 12.0 or later only. Install the release zip built for the matching Ghidra version through the extension manager, or build with gradle against GHIDRA_INSTALL_DIR, then enable the ReVa Application Plugin in the project view and the ReVa Plugin in the Code Browser. Release v7.3.1 (2026-09-03) ships zips for Ghidra 12.0, 12.1 and 12.1.3 with Sigstore bundles and a matching PyPI package; the reviewed main commit adds unreleased dependency updates and a breaking CLI migration to MCP Python SDK v2.

Assistant mode needs a running Ghidra with an open project and serves streamable HTTP on port 8080 by default. Headless mode needs GHIDRA_INSTALL_DIR, Python 3.10+ and the reverse-engineering-assistant package installed with uv, which provides the mcp-reva command; the README describes its projects as session-scoped and cleaned up automatically, created under .reva/projects in the working directory.

The server exposes Ghidra's PyGhidra scripting environment, and renaming and data-type tools change the project. Defaults bind 127.0.0.1 with scripting tools enabled and API-key authentication off; the README asks for API-key authentication or disabled scripting tools before listening on a public interface, and the reviewed source refuses an unauthenticated public binding in headless mode and asks for consent in the GUI.

Apache-2.0. The repository also publishes a Claude Code plugin marketplace with triage, deep-analysis, cryptography and CTF skills. README statements about context use and performance on large binaries or firmware images are the author's; no extension, server or analysis was run, and the reviewed sources establish no REA connection.

name: splat
description_en: Binary splitter for decompilation and modding projects: a YAML config says where and how to cut an N64 ROM or PSX, PS2 or PSP binary into code, data and asset segments. A scan phase disassembles code and data, with MIPS handled by spimdisasm; a split phase writes the files and a linker script for rebuilding the input. Custom segment types can extend the pipeline.
description_zh: 面向反编译与模组项目的二进制拆分工具：由 YAML 配置指定在何处、以何种方式把 N64 ROM 或 PSX、PS2、PSP 二进制切分为代码、数据和素材段。扫描阶段反汇编代码与数据，MIPS 部分由 spimdisasm 处理；拆分阶段写出文件以及用于重新构建输入文件的链接脚本。可编写自定义段类型扩展该流程。
requirements: Python 3.9+; install the splat64 package with the mips extra, which the N64, PSX, PS2 and PSP platforms require. The PyPI release at review was 0.50.1, uploaded 2026-10-10; 0.50.0 introduced breaking symbol and overlay changes. The repository has no GitHub releases, so this entry pins the reviewed main-branch commit.

Only the n64, psx, ps2 and psp platforms are documented; the overview calls PSX and PS2 support limited, the ELF quickstart excludes relocatable ELFs, and the README points GameCube/Wii projects to decomp-toolkit. create_config generates a starting YAML from a user-supplied ROM or ELF, which must then be refined segment by segment.

MIT license. splat splits, disassembles and emits a linker script; it does not decompile to C or by itself produce a matching build, and symbol names and types come from the analyst's optional symbol_addrs file. No binaries were split.

name: Mario Party 4: matching GameCube decompilation of the USA releases
description_en: Reconstructs Mario Party 4’s GameCube main executable and REL modules as C source that rebuilds both USA releases. The build analyzes the user’s own disc image and checks every linked output against version-specific SHA-1 lists. PAL and Japanese work is stale and no PC port exists yet; matching results remain project-reported here.
description_zh: 将 Mario Party 4 的 GameCube 主程序和 REL 模块重建为 C 源码，可重新构建两个美版发行版本。构建会分析使用者自备的光盘镜像，并按各版本的 SHA-1 清单检查每个链接产物。欧版和日版工作已停滞，也尚无 PC 移植；此处的一致性结果仍为项目报告。
requirements: README describes a work-in-progress decompilation whose two USA versions, GMPE01_00 (Rev 0) and GMPE01_01 (Rev 1), are completely matching; three PAL revisions and the Japanese release are unfinished and their work is stale. Most non-engine code is undocumented, and README states there is no working PC port yet.

Supply your own disc image for a supported game ID; README lists ISO (GCM), RVZ, WIA, WBFS, CISO, NFS, GCZ and TGC containers. The repository says it contains no game assets or assembly, and each version’s config checks the original main.dol hash before analysis.

Documented hosts are native Windows (Python and ninja), macOS (ninja and Wine Crossover) and Linux (ninja, with wibo fetched automatically on x86 or Wine elsewhere). configure.py pins decomp-toolkit, GameCube binutils, a Metrowerks CodeWarrior compiler bundle, objdiff, sjiswrap and wibo releases that the build downloads; the MusyX audio library is a pinned submodule.

The default build’s check step runs decomp-toolkit SHA-1 verification over main.dol and 99 REL modules listed for the selected version; objdiff supports per-object comparison. The mutable decomp.dev page reports GMPE01_00 as 100.00% decompiled and fully linked at the reviewed commit. This collection did not rerun these checks or play the game.

The repository is dedicated under CC0 1.0; the pinned MusyX submodule carries its own MIT license, and downloaded compilers and tools keep their own terms. The disc image and game content retain separate rights. The reviewed sources establish no AI or REA attribution, and no runtime reproduction is claimed.

name: SpeedBreaker: statically recompiling Need for Speed: Most Wanted for Xbox 360
description_en: Translates the Xbox 360 executable of Need for Speed: Most Wanted (2005) into native C++ with a patched XenonRecomp and runs it on a project runtime that stands in for the console’s kernel, Xenos GPU, XMA audio and controllers. Releases target SteamOS, Linux and Apple silicon Macs, with an experimental iPhone and iPad build, while all game data comes from the player’s own US disc. Rendering and frame-pacing improvements are project-reported.
description_zh: 使用打过补丁的 XenonRecomp 将 Xbox 360 版《极品飞车：最高通缉》（2005）的可执行文件转换为原生 C++，并在项目自建的运行时上执行，由运行时代替主机的内核、Xenos GPU、XMA 音频和控制器。发布版面向 SteamOS、Linux 和 Apple 芯片 Mac，另有实验性的 iPhone 与 iPad 版本，所有游戏数据均来自玩家自有的美版光盘。渲染与帧节奏方面的改进均为项目自述。
requirements: README describes an unofficial static recompilation of the Xbox 360 release, not an emulator, at v0.1.7 (October 2026). Windows and Android builds are announced but unavailable, there is no Intel Mac build, Xbox 360 saves cannot be imported, and the PC edition of the game is unsupported.

Requires a disc image or extracted files from the player’s own USA (NTSC-U) Xbox 360 disc; the installer verifies 49 files, and PAL, Japanese, re-release and Games on Demand copies are untested or unsupported. Source builds recompile the player’s default.xex, identified by size and SHA-256. Game files and the generated ppc/ code are git-ignored, and the README states that no game data or assets are distributed.

Running needs a Vulkan 1.2 GPU and an AVX2 x86-64 CPU on SteamOS or Linux, macOS 15+ on Apple silicon (Metal through MoltenVK), or iOS/iPadOS 17+ on an A15-class chip. Builds use Clang 18+ with lld, CMake and Ninja (on SteamOS inside an Arch distrobox), plus setup scripts for XenonRecomp with eight project patches, extract-xiso and a decoder-only FFmpeg for XMA; SDL3 and Dear ImGui provide the platform layer and UI.

Optional unit tests and instruction tests for the XenonRecomp patches need no game files, although one test needs the generated code; the instruction tests have so far run only on a Mac. Download tables list author- and player-reported devices, and several behaviors, including the IPA install and real 120 Hz displays, are marked untested. This collection did not build or run the port.

GPL-3.0-or-later with a NOTICE file; adapted Unleashed Recompiled runtime code, XenonRecomp, Xenia-derived headers, FFmpeg and other components keep the licenses listed in THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES. The project disclaims affiliation with EA and Valve. CONTRIBUTING accepts AI-assisted changes only when the contributor has read, understood and tested them; no REA use is established.

name: x64dbg-MCP Server
description_en: Native x64dbg plugin, written in Zig for both x32dbg and x64dbg, that serves an MCP endpoint over streamable HTTP and SSE from inside the debugger. Agents can load or attach to a process, set software, hardware, memory and conditional breakpoints, step and trace, read registers, call stacks, threads, memory maps, imports, strings and cross-references, and run arbitrary x64dbg commands. A bundled SKILL.md guide tells agents to confirm the debugger state before every action.
description_zh: 以 Zig 编写、同时支持 x32dbg 与 x64dbg 的原生 x64dbg 插件，在调试器内部通过 streamable HTTP 和 SSE 提供 MCP 端点。智能体可以加载或附加进程，设置软件、硬件、内存及条件断点，单步与跟踪执行，读取寄存器、调用栈、线程、内存映射、导入表、字符串和交叉引用，并执行任意 x64dbg 命令。随附的 SKILL.md 指南要求智能体在每次操作前先确认调试器状态。
requirements: Windows with x64dbg; the plugin loads into x32dbg or x64dbg and resolves the debugger API at runtime. Install by copying the x32 and x64 plugin folders from the v1.6 release zip (2026-10-12) or a dist/ build into the x64dbg root; building needs Zig 0.16-dev or later and can cross-compile from Linux, macOS or WSL. The server starts automatically with the debugger.

Ports are 9094 for x64 and 9095 for x32. The README lists 0.0.0.0 as the default bind address, but the reviewed configuration code has defaulted to 127.0.0.1 since v1.2; the plugin's config dialog changes the address, port and token and saves them to mcp_config.json beside the x64dbg executable. A bearer token generated on first run is required on every request, and traffic is unencrypted HTTP, so the README warns against exposing the server to untrusted networks.

Many tools change the target or debugger state: memory writes and patches, instruction assembly, register writes, memory allocation, thread suspension, breakpoint commands and arbitrary debugger commands. DumpMemory and DumpModule write files to disk, and OEP detection and module dumping are aimed at packed executables.

MIT. The README limits use to authorized reverse engineering, malware analysis, security research and education. No plugin, debugger session or target was run, and the reviewed sources establish no REA connection.

name: The Sims: Bustin' Out: an AI-driven partial GBA matching decompilation
description_en: Rebuilds the USA/Europe Game Boy Advance release of The Sims: Bustin' Out byte for byte while gradually replacing ROM regions with matching C compiled by agbcc. The README calls it an AI-driven experiment in which almost all code, analysis and tooling are AI-generated. Most of the ROM is still copied from the user’s dump, so whole-ROM equality does not mean the game has been decompiled.
description_zh: 逐字节重建 The Sims: Bustin' Out 的 Game Boy Advance 美欧版，并逐步用 agbcc 编译、结果一致的 C 代码替换 ROM 区域。README 称这是由 AI 驱动的实验，几乎所有代码、分析与工具都由 AI 生成。ROM 的大部分仍从使用者的转储中复制，因此整个 ROM 一致并不代表游戏已完成反编译。
requirements: The progress report at this commit (verified 18 Oct 2026) counts 2,285 matching C functions covering 288,700 bytes and 4,060 bytes of assembly glue, while 16,484,456 of the 16,777,216 ROM bytes remain unconverted. It marks the code inventory as incomplete, and the README treats function boundaries in the ROM map as provisional.

Requires the user’s own USA/Europe revision 0 ROM (game code ASIE) matching SHA-1 fb5662172fadebf4577f6f6f163741fc041c11e6; unconverted regions in the built ROM come from that dump. A USA revision 1 dump serves only as an audit and comparison reference. ROMs, extracted assets and game binaries are not included.

The documented build host is macOS with Python 3.10+ and Xcode’s command line tools. The pinned toolchain uses pret/agbcc as the matching C compiler, selected GCC 3.0.2 and Binutils 2.10.1 builds with host-compatibility patches, Binutils 2.43.1, Capstone, pyelftools and Pillow. The README notes that choosing these tools does not establish the original game’s toolchain.

make build fails if any byte differs, and each verified build includes changed-source negative controls that must be rejected; make test runs tests without a ROM. mGBA is listed only for optional bounded runtime observations, and no gameplay equivalence is claimed. This review did not build or run the project.

MIT covers the project’s own source, tools and documentation, not original game code, assets, trademarks or Nintendo’s header logo. Adapted Krawall routines (LGPL-2.1), selected GCC runtime sources (GPL-2.0 with exceptions) and Newlib string functions keep their own notices. The project accepts no contributions; the agents or models used are not named, and no REA use is established.

name: m2c
description_en: Decompiler for matching projects that turns GNU as-format 32-bit MIPS, ARM, PowerPC and SuperH assembly into draft C, with partial C++ support. A target combines platform, compiler (IDO, GCC or MetroWerks CodeWarrior) and language; context files supply types, and it can infer unknown struct fields and emit global initializers. The README places it alongside splat, asm-differ and decomp-permuter, and decomp.me calls it for initial decompilations.
description_zh: 面向匹配反编译项目的反编译器，将 GNU as 格式的 32 位 MIPS、ARM、PowerPC 和 SuperH 汇编转换为 C 代码初稿，并部分支持 C++。目标由平台、编译器（IDO、GCC 或 MetroWerks CodeWarrior）和语言组成；上下文文件提供类型信息，还能推断未知的结构体字段并生成全局变量初始化代码。README 将它与 splat、asm-differ 和 decomp-permuter 并列使用，decomp.me 也调用它生成初步反编译结果。
requirements: Python 3.8+ with graphviz. Run m2c.py from a checkout or install it from the Git repository as a Python package; the package named m2c on PyPI is an unrelated project. There are no releases or tags, so this entry pins the reviewed master commit (last commit at review: 2026-09-16).

Input must match the GNU as assembly format, such as spimdisasm output. The README lists the mips, mipsel, mipsee (eabi64), ppc, arm, gba (APCS) and sh2 platforms, the ido, gcc and mwcc compilers, and the c and c++ languages. Struct-field inference skips structs with bitfields or unnamed union fields, and initializers cannot be generated for bitfield structs or symbols of unknown type.

GPL-3.0-only. The README warns that output is sometimes suboptimal, especially for loops; it is a starting point to refine and check with a compiler and diff tool, not byte-identical source. No assembly was decompiled.

name: Destiny 2 build 86657: Sunrise/Dawn reconstruction research report
description_en: A dated research report on the Sunrise/Dawn reconstruction of the archived Destiny 2 build 86657 client, which emulates platform sign-on and the examined Bungie service contracts locally and adds reconstructed mission host policy. It records transport, decoding, object creation, presentation and gameplay results separately, and keeps superseded conclusions with their cited sources. It documents the case rather than shipping the runtime implementation or a recovered Bungie backend; playthroughs and native results remain project-reported.
description_zh: 一份注明版本日期的研究报告，记录已归档 Destiny 2 build 86657 客户端的 Sunrise／Dawn 重建：在本地模拟平台登录与所考察的 Bungie 服务契约，并补充重建的任务主机策略。报告把传输、解码、对象创建、呈现与游戏玩法结果分开记录，并连同所引来源保留已被推翻的结论。它记录案例本身，不提供运行时实现，也不是恢复出的 Bungie 后端；通关与原生实验结果仍为项目报告。
requirements: The reviewed edition is dated 21 September 2026: 20 chapters, 289 source records (280 Markdown notes, two PDF text extracts and seven source excerpts) and hash inventories of 2,832 implementation files and 336 lanes-archive files. It covers BAP secure services, matchmaking and peer channels, activity replication, package schemas, mission reconstructions, persistence and native hooks for build 86657.20.08.23.1800.d2_rc. The report states that its corpus does not establish Bungie’s complete backend or a general interpreter for original missions.

Native work depends on a separately obtained archived Destiny 2 build 86657 client and its game packages; the report neither supplies them nor explains how to obtain them. Game binaries, package payloads, artwork, a manifest database, credentials, personal saves, raw runtime captures and the two supplied PDFs are not published. Several referenced binary fixtures and traces are also absent, which the report names as a limit on independent reproduction from this repository.

The described reconstruction runs as a proxy DLL inside the game process, combining Steam platform-interface and sign-on emulation, an embedded service layer, C++ native contracts and Lua or C++ mission definitions. ATTRIBUTION.md names the separate Dawn project as the reconstruction and integration work, building on Sunrise and Sundial research. Its source was collected from a modified worktree based on commit e801e23e, so file hashes rather than that commit identify the captured files; checking the report itself needs only Python and its two bundled scripts.

The bundled validation record reports passing checks of report assembly, 1,191 local links, citations, evidence hashes, 37 claim references and selected publication exclusions, with no game or native runtime tests. Its acceptance table records a complete Omega run, accepted sections of other missions and an Eater of Worlds slice that excludes the barrier and Argos fights; Spark live testing, coherent native-world resume and detached camera behavior remain unverified or unimplemented. This collection read the report and evidence metadata without running its scripts, the game or the implementation.

No repository-wide license is declared. ATTRIBUTION.md retains Dawn’s GPL-3.0 text for the included source excerpts, credits Sunrise and Sundial contributors, asserts no Bungie endorsement and does not relicense third-party material. The report concerns local reconstruction of an archived build, and states that its security findings are not vulnerability claims against the current online game. It does not document Claude or other AI-assisted decompilation or recreated in-engine assets, and the reviewed sources establish no REA connection.

name: SVR2011-Recomp: a ReXGlue recompilation of WWE SmackDown vs. Raw 2011
description_en: Translates the Xbox 360 executable of WWE SmackDown vs. Raw 2011 to C++ ahead of time with ReXGlue and builds it as a Windows program on a Vulkan runtime derived from Xenia. A hand-maintained manifest adds function entry points the automatic pass misses, and project patches address frame pacing, a music-player delay and pipeline stalls. Exhibition play is author-tested on one AMD GPU; career mode and online remain untested.
description_zh: 借助 ReXGlue 将 WWE SmackDown vs. Raw 2011 的 Xbox 360 可执行文件提前转换为 C++，并在源自 Xenia 的 Vulkan 运行时上构建为 Windows 程序。手工维护的清单补充自动分析遗漏的函数入口，项目补丁则处理帧节奏、音乐播放器延迟和渲染管线卡顿。作者仅在一款 AMD GPU 上测试了表演赛等模式；生涯模式与在线功能仍未测试。
requirements: The reviewed main branch (the v0.5.0 release commit) is a static recompilation, not a decompilation; its feasibility notes stress that translated code is not recovered developer source. The build accepts only the default.xex with SHA-256 6aead4cb…d3ebc1, and svr2011_manifest.toml seeds indirect-call targets that ReXGlue v0.10.0 misses. README reports exhibition matches, entrances, menus, backstage brawls and the Create a Superstar tools as playable; Road to WrestleMania, other create modes, Universe and online are untested and may crash.

The player supplies an Xbox 360 disc image of the USA/Europe release. The launcher checks all 366 files against that release, refuses other images and copies the files into gamedata once. README states that the repository contains no game code or data and that the build generates both from the user’s image; the player zip carries the built executable, ReXGlue runtime DLLs and prebuilt shaders, but no disc files.

Play needs 64-bit Windows 10 or 11 (only Windows 11 was tested), a Vulkan GPU with a current driver and about 6 GB of space. Source builds need about 25 GB, PowerShell 7, Python 3, Git, 7-Zip and Visual Studio 2026 Build Tools with CMake, Ninja and the Windows SDK; bootstrap.ps1 downloads SHA-256-pinned ReXGlue 0.10.0 and LLVM 21.1.8. The Vulkan renderer must be selected, because the default D3D12 path hangs on the tested GPU.

Testing is reported on Windows 11 with an AMD Radeon RX 7900 XT; other GPUs and Windows 10 have not been tried. Python and PowerShell tests cover disc inspection, shader-cache merging, the launcher and portable setup with a synthetic image, and dated notes record the boot and frame-time investigations. These are author reports, not equivalence checks; this collection did not run them.

The project’s own code is BSD 3-Clause; ReXGlue is used under its own license, and the project scaffold and generated/rexglue.cmake come from ReXGlue templates. The game remains with its rights holders, and README asks users not to share gamedata, assets or disc images. README states no AI or REA use; a docs/agents work-tracking note exists, but no attribution is inferred from it.

name: mcp-windbg
description_en: Independent, community-built MCP server that runs Microsoft's cdb.exe and kd.exe headless, so agents can open and triage user-mode and kernel crash dumps, attach to cdb remote debug servers and KD kernel targets, and run arbitrary debugger commands in separately addressed sessions. Its README points users who want AI inside WinDbg to Microsoft's official WinDbg MCP and positions this project as an alternative for other MCP clients, remote HTTP use and batch dump triage; it calls itself a wrapper that runs real debugger commands, not an automatic fix.
description_zh: 由社区独立开发的 MCP 服务器，以无界面方式运行微软的 cdb.exe 和 kd.exe，使智能体能够打开并初步分析用户态与内核崩溃转储，连接 cdb 远程调试服务器和 KD 内核目标，并在可分别寻址的会话中执行任意调试器命令。其 README 建议希望在 WinDbg 内使用 AI 的用户选择微软官方的 WinDbg MCP，并把本项目定位为面向其他 MCP 客户端、远程 HTTP 使用和批量转储分析的替代方案；项目自称只是执行真实调试器命令的封装，而非自动修复工具。
requirements: Windows with Debugging Tools for Windows or WinDbg from the Microsoft Store, which provide cdb.exe and kd.exe. Install from PyPI (mcp-windbg 1.5.1, Python 3.10+), through the uvx-based Claude Code plugin, or as the signed standalone mcp-windbg.exe attached to each release with SHA256SUMS; optional plugins add four skills and a crash-analyst agent. The reviewed develop commit is one commit after v1.5.1 (2026-10-10).

Symbols come from _NT_SYMBOL_PATH or --symbols-path, typically the Microsoft symbol server. Remote user-mode debugging needs a running cdb or WinDbg debug server; kernel sessions need a KD-enabled machine or VM reached over KDNET, a named pipe or serial, and closing a kernel session resumes the target.

stdio is the default transport. The streamable HTTP transport binds 127.0.0.1:8000 by default and has no authentication: anyone who can reach the port can drive cdb.exe on the host, so the docs advise a trusted network, an SSH tunnel or an authenticating proxy. A --filter-script hook can redact data from tool arguments and output before they leave the machine.

MIT. Microsoft's official WinDbg MCP, which the README dates from WinDbg 1.2610.1001.0, is a separate product not covered by this entry. No dumps, live targets or kernel sessions were analyzed, and the reviewed sources establish no REA connection.

name: decomp-toolkit
description_en: GameCube/Wii matching-decompilation toolkit that analyzes DOL and REL executables and, from a project configuration, splits them into relocatable objects plus an ldscript.lcf for CodeWarrior's linker, so decompiled objects can replace original ones while the relinked binary is checked against the original. Analysis covers function boundaries, a Metrowerks/SDK signature database, relocations, sections and data objects, and objects are written without an assembler. Its CLI also handles disc images, archives, compression formats, CodeWarrior demangling and DWARF dumps.
description_zh: 面向 GameCube/Wii 匹配反编译的工具包：分析 DOL 和 REL 可执行文件，按项目配置将其拆分为可重定位目标文件，并为 CodeWarrior 链接器生成 ldscript.lcf，使反编译出的目标文件可逐个替换原有部分，同时将重新链接的二进制与原版核对。分析涵盖函数边界、Metrowerks/SDK 签名库、重定位、节区和数据对象，且无需汇编器即可直接写出目标文件。其命令行还可处理光盘镜像、归档、压缩格式、CodeWarrior 符号还原和 DWARF 转储。
requirements: Distributed as a single portable binary: release v1.8.4, published 2026-09-09, provides Linux x86_64/i686/aarch64, macOS arm64/x86_64 and Windows x86_64/x86/arm64 builds. The reviewed main commit is one commit ahead of that tag, restoring a metroidbuildinfo command. Building from source needs Rust 1.85+.

dol split is intended to run inside a decompilation project's build system; the README points new projects to dtk-template for project structure and configuration documentation. Matching builds often need the original game's compiler, Metrowerks CodeWarrior on GameCube/Wii, and the generated linker script targets mwldeppc.exe. DOL/REL files and disc images must come from the user's own game copies.

Dual-licensed MIT OR Apache-2.0. It analyzes, splits and relinks binaries; it does not decompile to C, and dol diff only reports the most obvious difference in a linked ELF, so per-function matching is checked with tools such as objdiff. No game files were analyzed.

name: Snap64 Recomp: a static-recompilation port of Pokémon Snap
description_en: Uses N64Recomp to statically recompile the US Nintendo 64 release of Pokémon Snap into a native Windows, Linux, Steam Deck and macOS port rendered with RT64. The recompiler reads a relocatable ELF linked from the matching ethteck/pokemonsnap decompilation together with the user’s ROM, and game-side patches are modified copies of decompiled functions. The author reports building the port with Claude Code; results remain project-reported.
description_zh: 使用 N64Recomp 将 Pokémon Snap 美版 Nintendo 64 发行版静态重编译为原生 Windows、Linux、Steam Deck 和 macOS 移植，由 RT64 负责渲染。重编译器读取从一致性 ethteck/pokemonsnap 反编译项目链接出的可重定位 ELF 及使用者自备的 ROM，游戏侧补丁则是反编译函数的修改副本。作者报告借助 Claude Code 完成移植；各项结果仍为项目报告。
requirements: The reviewed tree is version 1.1.5, published as release v1.1.5 on 2026-10-17, and targets only the US cartridge; README says the Japanese, European and Australian releases are different builds. Cartridge behavior is the default and every enhancement is opt-in. Listed known issues include some 2D elements stepping at the game’s rate at higher frame rates, estimated Snap Station printer details and lightly tested Vulkan on Windows.

Supply your own US ROM matching the SHA-1 in README, the checksum the decompilation publishes; .z64, .v64 and .n64 files are accepted and a wrong file is refused. The repository and releases contain no game assets. Building also needs that ROM for the matching decompilation build, the recompiler inputs and the RSP audio-microcode translation.

Releases need 64-bit Windows 10 (1809+) or 11 with Direct3D 12 Shader Model 6.3, Linux or Steam Deck with Vulkan 1.2 (experimental), or macOS 14+, on an SSE4.1 x86-64 CPU or the ARM builds provided. BUILDING.md records a two-machine build: WSL Ubuntu 24.04 with MIPS binutils, the decompilation, its downloaded IDO compilers and N64Recomp, then Visual Studio 2019, CMake 3.20+ and Python 3 on Windows after tools/fetch_deps.py checks out the pinned submodules. The relocatable-ELF relink is marked as derived, not recorded.

VERIFICATION.md reports a full Windows play-through, partial Steam Deck and GitHub-hosted virtual Mac runs, and 33 of 33 headless-suite checks plus 5 of 5 Snap Station checks on the author’s 1.1.5 executable from recorded replays. These test the port’s behavior, not byte-level equivalence with the cartridge; no physical Mac or Linux desktop report is recorded. This collection did not build or run it.

Port code is GPLv3, with third-party components listed in NOTICE.md. NOTICE.md says no tracked file carries ROM bytes, but the distributed executable is compiled from C that N64Recomp translates from the game’s instructions, and patches are modified decompiled functions; the game remains its owners’. The author reports writing the port with Claude Code under their direction; no REA use is documented.

name: Dead Rising 2: Case Zero — an Xbox 360 XBLA static recompilation port
description_en: Builds a native Windows, Linux, Steam Deck and Apple Silicon port of the XBLA game Dead Rising 2: Case Zero by statically recompiling its Xbox 360 code with patched XenonRecomp and translating its shaders with patched XenosRecomp. A purpose-built runtime supplies a Vulkan renderer, XMA audio, keyboard/mouse input and online co-op through the author’s XenonLive service. Completion and platform results are project-reported.
description_zh: 使用打过补丁的 XenonRecomp 静态重编译 Xbox 360 代码，并用打过补丁的 XenosRecomp 转换着色器，为 XBLA 游戏 Dead Rising 2: Case Zero 构建可在 Windows、Linux、Steam Deck 和 Apple Silicon Mac 上运行的原生移植。专门编写的运行时提供 Vulkan 渲染器、XMA 音频、键鼠输入，以及通过作者的 XenonLive 服务实现的在线合作。通关情况与各平台结果均为项目报告。
requirements: Requires the user’s own XBLA package for title 58410A8D (about 825 MB, no file extension) in assets/package; the first run unpacks it and prepares the 1,367 shaders and the menu and prompt assets locally. No game data is committed or shipped: assets/ and the ppc/ C++ generated from the retail executable are gitignored, and the committed key-cap prompt chips are the project’s own art.

Releases need a Vulkan 1.3 GPU with Windows 10+ x86-64, Linux x86-64 with glibc 2.35+, the Steam Deck archive, or macOS 13+ on Apple Silicon; Intel Macs are unsupported, and about 2 GB is needed after unpacking. Source builds need hedge-dev XenonRecomp and XenosRecomp at the base commits in patches/README.md with the 14 and 23 exported patches, a sibling XenonLive checkout at configure time, CMake and Ninja; ppc/ must first be regenerated from config/CaseZero.toml.

The README declares the project finished at v1.1.3 (October 2026) and completable solo and in two-player online co-op on Windows and Linux, with a raised level cap, 60 fps, a restored PC options screen and ultrawide support. The Steam Deck and macOS builds are the least tested; the macOS build can freeze after about 15 idle minutes, and streaming pop-in and sign holes remain open. The maintainer has stopped work, so issues may go unanswered.

CI builds the host runtime on Linux and Windows and smoke-tests it against a stub image; that run succeeded for the reviewed commit but cannot run the game, so playthroughs are maintainer reports. The patch notes say both exported patch sets reproduce the recompiler checkouts used for v1.1.3. This collection did not build or run the port.

Project code is under PolyForm Noncommercial 1.0.0, which permits noncommercial use, modification and forks but not sale; XenonRecomp and XenosRecomp are MIT, and Capcom retains the game’s rights. THIRD_PARTY.md says UnleashedRecomp served only as a structural reference, with no GPL code copied. The development journal is committed as CLAUDE.md, but the README states no AI-use policy; no REA connection is established.

name: OpenRA: an engine reimplementation reimagining early Westwood RTS games
description_en: Provides a C# engine for early Westwood real-time strategy games, with mods that reimagine Command & Conquer: Red Alert, Tiberian Dawn and Dune 2000. It loads the original games’ content through its own file-system, MiniYAML rules and Lua mission layers rather than running or recovering Westwood code. Gameplay and interface deliberately follow OpenRA’s own design, so it is not a faithful recreation of the original executables.
description_zh: 为早期 Westwood 即时战略游戏提供以 C# 编写的引擎，并以模组形式重新诠释 Command & Conquer: Red Alert、Tiberian Dawn 和 Dune 2000。它通过自己的文件系统、MiniYAML 规则和 Lua 任务层加载原游戏内容，而不是运行或恢复 Westwood 的代码。玩法和界面有意遵循 OpenRA 自身的设计，因此并非对原可执行文件的忠实重现。
requirements: The reviewed bleed (development) snapshot postdates release-20250330 and carries a development version placeholder. The README lists the Red Alert, Tiberian Dawn and Dune 2000 mods as reimaginings, and INSTALL calls the Tiberian Sun mod experimental. No Westwood source code is recovered or reproduced.

INSTALL states that several files from the original game disks are needed; for Red Alert, the content manifest checks for archives such as allies.mix and conquer.mix. The content installers recognise original discs, The First Decade and the Steam or Origin editions, including the Remastered Collection, or install a minimal asset pack hosted by the project. Commit history shows that some supplementary sounds and icons under mods/*/bits came from Westwood games such as Sole Survivor, and the reviewed sources state no separate licence for them.

Building needs the .NET 10 SDK: make on Linux and macOS, or make.ps1 and dotnet on Windows. On x86_64 Linux the build fetches prebuilt native libraries through NuGet by default; other systems use system SDL 2, FreeType, OpenAL and Lua 5.1.

CI on Linux and Windows runs code checks, the OpenRA.Test unit tests, Lua script checks and MiniYAML validation for every mod. These checks cover the engine and mod data, not equivalence with the original games, and this review ran none of them.

COPYING applies GPL-3.0-or-later to OpenRA, and AUTHORS lists bundled libraries under their own terms, such as zlib for SDL2-CS and OpenAL-CS and MIT for Eluant. The README states that EA has not endorsed and does not support the project. Original game content keeps its own rights; no REA or AI use is established.

name: Rizin
description_en: Command-line reverse-engineering framework that began as a fork of radare2. The rizin shell analyzes and disassembles binaries, debugs programs and works as a scriptable hex editor, while rz-* tools cover binary-format information, assembly, diffing, hashing, pattern search and FLIRT signatures. The README lists dozens of architectures, bytecode formats and file formats from ELF, PE and Mach-O to dyld caches and BIOS/UEFI images; rzpipe scripts it from Python, Rust, Go and other languages. Cutter is the separate GUI built on it.
description_zh: 源自 radare2 分支的命令行逆向工程框架。rizin 交互环境可分析和反汇编二进制、调试程序，并可用作可脚本化的十六进制编辑器；rz-* 系列工具提供二进制格式信息、汇编、差异比较、哈希、模式搜索和 FLIRT 签名等功能。README 列出数十种架构、字节码格式和文件格式，从 ELF、PE、Mach-O 到 dyld 缓存和 BIOS/UEFI 镜像；可通过 rzpipe 用 Python、Rust、Go 等语言编写脚本。Cutter 是基于它的独立图形界面。
requirements: Latest release at review: v0.9.1, published 2026-06-29, with a static Linux x86_64 build, a macOS package, Windows installers and static/shared archives, Android arm, aarch64 and x86_64 archives and a source tarball. The reviewed dev branch already declares the unreleased v0.10.0; this entry pins that commit for documentation only.

Source builds use meson and ninja; meson.build requires meson 0.58.0+, although the README mentions 0.55.0. The README lists Windows 7+, macOS/iOS/iPadOS, GNU/Linux, the BSDs, Android, QNX, Solaris/Illumos, Haiku and GNU/Hurd hosts. rzpipe lives in a separate repository, and plugins, including decompiler plugins, were not reviewed.

meson.build declares LGPL-3.0-only, with COPYING and COPYING.LESSER; the LICENSES directory holds further licenses used by individual files. Listed architecture and format support was not exercised; no binaries were analyzed.

name: Cheat Engine MCP Bridge
description_en: Connects MCP clients to Cheat Engine through a Lua bridge script and a Python MCP server, so an agent can inspect a process the user runs under Cheat Engine: memory reads and value scans, pointer-chain resolution, structure dissection, RTTI class names, disassembly, cross-references and hardware or DBVM breakpoints. Further tool groups write memory, inject DLLs or code, automate input and use Cheat Engine's kernel-mode driver. The README limits it to educational and research use and disclaims multiplayer cheating and Terms of Service violations.
description_zh: 通过 Lua 桥接脚本和 Python MCP 服务器把 MCP 客户端连接到 Cheat Engine，使智能体能够检查用户在 Cheat Engine 下运行的进程：读取内存与扫描数值、解析指针链、剖析结构体、识别 RTTI 类名、反汇编、查找交叉引用，以及设置硬件或 DBVM 断点。另有工具组可写入内存、注入 DLL 或代码、自动化输入，并调用 Cheat Engine 的内核模式驱动。README 将其限定于教学和研究用途，并声明不支持多人游戏作弊或违反服务条款的行为。
requirements: Windows with Cheat Engine; the bridge is loaded by executing MCP_Server/ce_mcp_bridge.lua from Cheat Engine, and the repository's bundled Lua reference documents Cheat Engine 7.6. The Python MCP server needs Python 3.10+, mcp>=1.28,<2 (the MCP SDK v2 API is not yet supported) and pywin32 for the native named-pipe mode, which is Windows-only. There are no GitHub releases; the README labels the code v12.0.0, and the reviewed main commit is dated 2026-08-14.

A TCP relay (ce_tcp_relay.py, default 127.0.0.1:9876) lets the MCP server run outside the Windows host. The README warns that anyone who can reach the relay can control the bridge and says to bind it to trusted interfaces only. run_command and shell_execute stay disabled in the Python MCP server unless CE_MCP_ALLOW_SHELL=1 is set at startup.

Before use, disable Settings → Extra → Query memory region routines in Cheat Engine; the README warns that leaving it enabled causes CLOCK_WATCHDOG_TIMEOUT blue screens with DBVM or anti-cheat software. DBVM tools need DBVM enabled, and kernel-mode tools rely on Cheat Engine's DBK driver.

Memory-write, allocation, injection, process-creation, window-message and key-press tools change the target or the desktop session. MIT. The project's test script needs a live Cheat Engine session; no bridge, game or target process was run here, no game compatibility is implied, and the reviewed sources establish no REA connection.

name: Dead Rising 2: Case West — a sibling Xbox 360 XBLA static recompilation port
description_en: Builds a native Windows, Linux, Steam Deck and Apple Silicon port of the XBLA epilogue Dead Rising 2: Case West by statically recompiling its Xbox 360 code with patched XenonRecomp and translating its shaders with patched XenosRecomp. It shares most of its runtime with the author’s separate Case Zero port, executing the console GPU command stream on Vulkan with XMA audio and keyboard/mouse input. Completion and platform results are project-reported.
description_zh: 使用打过补丁的 XenonRecomp 静态重编译 Xbox 360 代码，并用打过补丁的 XenosRecomp 转换着色器，为 XBLA 尾声篇 Dead Rising 2: Case West 构建可在 Windows、Linux、Steam Deck 和 Apple Silicon Mac 上运行的原生移植。它与作者另一个 Case Zero 移植共用大部分运行时，在 Vulkan 上执行主机 GPU 命令流，并提供 XMA 音频和键鼠输入。通关情况与各平台结果均为项目报告。
requirements: Requires the user’s own XBLA package for title 58410B00 (about 1.2 GB, no file extension) in assets/package; the first run unpacks it and prepares the 1,322 shaders and the keyboard prompt art locally. No game data is committed or shipped: assets/ and the ppc/ C++ generated from the retail executable are gitignored, and the committed key-cap chips are the project’s own art.

Releases need a Vulkan 1.3 GPU with Windows 10+ x86-64, Linux x86-64 with glibc 2.35+, the Steam Deck archive, or macOS 13+ on Apple Silicon; Intel Macs are unsupported, and about 3 GB is needed after unpacking. Source builds apply the two combined patches in tools/ci to hedge-dev XenonRecomp and XenosRecomp at the base commits pinned in the CI workflow, need a sibling XenonLive checkout, CMake and Ninja, and first regenerate ppc/ from config/CaseWest.toml.

The README declares v1.1.2 (October 2026) the final build: single-player is completable start to finish, and two-player online co-op works only when started from the XenonLive launcher. It reports 58,345 recompiled PowerPC functions, 60 fps, an in-game graphics menu and ultrawide and 16:10 support. Shading differences and an AMD-only black square remain known issues, and the Steam Deck build has not been tested on Deck hardware.

CI is meant to build the host runtime on Linux and Windows against a stub ppc/ tree, but its run for the reviewed commit skipped both build jobs because the XenonLive deploy key was unavailable, and CI cannot run the game in any case. Playthroughs and fixes imported from Case Zero are the maintainer’s reports; this collection did not build or run the port.

Project code is under PolyForm Noncommercial 1.0.0, which permits noncommercial use, modification and forks but not sale; XenonRecomp and XenosRecomp are MIT, and Capcom retains the game’s rights. THIRD_PARTY.md was copied from the Case Zero port and says no UnleashedRecomp GPL code is used. The development journal is committed as CLAUDE.md, but the README states no AI-use policy; no REA connection is established.

name: Decompiler Explorer
description_en: Web service at dogbolt.org that runs one small uploaded executable through many decompilers and shows their C-like output side by side, described as Compiler Explorer in reverse. The pinned source has runners for angr, Binary Ninja, Boomerang, dewolf, Ghidra, Hex-Rays, Kuna, REC Studio, Reko, Relyze, RetDec, rev.ng and Snowman, which helps compare how different decompilers render the same code.
description_zh: 位于 dogbolt.org 的网络服务：将上传的单个小型可执行文件交给多款反编译器处理，并排显示它们输出的类 C 代码，自称“反向的 Compiler Explorer”。所固定版本的源码包含 angr、Binary Ninja、Boomerang、dewolf、Ghidra、Hex-Rays、Kuna、REC Studio、Reko、Relyze、RetDec、rev.ng 和 Snowman 的运行器，便于比较不同反编译器如何呈现同一段代码。
requirements: The public service saves every submitted binary and makes it available to the authors of the included decompilers, so do not upload confidential, proprietary or other binaries you may not share. There is intentionally no public automation API; automating comparisons requires terms from the respective license holders.

Self-hosting needs Python 3.8+, pipenv, Docker and docker-compose; scripts/dce.py builds the decompiler images and starts the service. Binary Ninja and Hex-Rays images need the operator's own binaries and license files. The FAQ forbids public instances that include the commercial tools and says private instances depend on each vendor's license terms.

MIT license (Vector 35 Inc.); no tagged releases, so this entry pins the reviewed master commit. As the FAQ notes, decompiler results vary with compiler, settings, language, architecture and complexity; the decompiler versions on the live site were not reviewed and no binaries were uploaded.

name: Wireshark MCP
description_en: MCP server that wraps tshark, and optionally other Wireshark command-line tools, so agents can query saved captures through Wireshark's dissectors: packet lists and details, stream following, arbitrary field extraction, protocol hierarchies and conversations, decode-as rules for non-standard ports, protocol preferences, TLS and WPA decryption with user-supplied keys, and one tool that applies preset fields and filters for 25 protocols such as Modbus, S7comm, MQTT, Zigbee and BLE. Separate security-heuristic, live-capture and capture-editing tools sit beside the dissection tools.
description_zh: 封装 tshark 及可选的其他 Wireshark 命令行工具的 MCP 服务器，使智能体能借助 Wireshark 的解析器查询已保存的抓包文件：数据包列表与详情、流追踪、任意字段提取、协议层级与会话统计、针对非标准端口的 decode-as 规则、协议首选项、使用用户提供的密钥进行 TLS 与 WPA 解密，以及一个为 Modbus、S7comm、MQTT、Zigbee、BLE 等 25 种协议套用预设字段和过滤器的工具。解析类工具之外，另有安全启发式检测、实时抓包和抓包文件编辑等独立工具。
requirements: Python 3.10+ and Wireshark with tshark on PATH; capinfos, mergecap, editcap, dumpcap and text2pcap are auto-detected optional extras, and live capture needs the platform's capture drivers and permissions. Install from PyPI (wireshark-mcp 3.1.0, built on MCP Python SDK 2.x) with its client installer, or through the Claude Code or Codex plugin route with uv. Reviewed at the v3.1.0 tag, released 2026-10-18 at the main head; the project changes quickly.

stdio is the default transport. SSE and streamable HTTP bind 127.0.0.1 by default and are unauthenticated, so the server refuses a non-loopback bind unless --allow-insecure-http is passed behind a trusted authenticated TLS proxy. The 11 file-writing tools (live capture, merge, filter-save, editcap, text2pcap, frame and object export) fail closed until WIRESHARK_MCP_ALLOWED_DIRS names existing directories; --profile analysis or core advertises fewer tools.

Protocol results come from Wireshark's existing dissectors and preset field lists; decode-as rules and preferences only redirect or configure those dissectors, and the server does not infer unknown message formats. Credential, scan, tunnelling, beaconing, exfiltration and YARA tools are security heuristics rather than protocol reverse engineering, and their findings need analyst review.

MIT; Wireshark and its tools keep their own GPL terms. REA's packet-capture guide documents a separate TShark workflow inside REA; this independent server establishes no REA connection. No server, capture or analysis was run.

name: The Simpsons Wrestling Recompiled: a psxrecomp PlayStation static recompilation
description_en: Translates the PlayStation game’s MIPS code to C with a pinned psxrecomp fork and builds Windows and Linux programs on its hardware-modelling runtime, with a launcher and a game-specific plugin. Without patching game code, the plugin adds 16:9 matches, 60 FPS by raising the emulated CPU clock and rescaling movement, intro skipping and unlocks. The user’s own NTSC-U disc image is required, and the measurements are author-reported.
description_zh: 借助固定版本的 psxrecomp 分支，将这款 PlayStation 游戏的 MIPS 代码转换为 C，并基于其模拟硬件行为的运行时构建 Windows 与 Linux 程序，另附启动器和专用插件。插件在不修补游戏代码的前提下，实现比赛中的 16:9 画面、通过提高模拟 CPU 频率并修正移动量达到 60 FPS、跳过片头及全部解锁。需使用者自备 NTSC-U 光盘镜像；测量结果为作者报告。
requirements: The reviewed master branch (VERSION 1.0.0, matching the v1.0.0 release) is a static recompilation, not a decompilation: psxrecomp translates SLUS_012.27’s R3000A code into a local generated/ tree using Ghidra-derived function seeds. psxrecomp is a pinned submodule from TekRantGaming’s fork of RetroPortingToolKit/psxrecomp, whose README describes a hardware-accurate runtime with bundled OpenBIOS as the default, so a retail BIOS is not normally required. Known issues include misplaced widescreen pause-screen HUD elements and uneven experimental 120 FPS.

The user supplies The Simpsons Wrestling (PlayStation, North America, SLUS-01227) as a .cue with its .bin. game.toml records the expected data-track size and hashes; the launcher checks the disc before play and reads it in place. Building also needs that disc to generate the C code. README states that the repository holds no game code and that the download contains no game files.

Play needs 64-bit Windows 10/11 or 64-bit Linux with glibc 2.38, plus OpenGL 3.3. Windows builds use Visual Studio 2022 Build Tools, CMake, Ninja and the bundled clang-cl with ThinLTO and a committed PGO profile; Linux builds use gcc with X11, Wayland, GL, ALSA, PulseAudio and udev development packages. The launcher is a separate SDL2 program from the TRG Launcher submodule, while the runtime uses SDL3.

TECHNICAL.md reports attract-demo matches in two arenas at 1.00x speed and a steady 60 FPS on one Ryzen 7 7800X3D/RTX 4070 Ti PC, plus jump-height and walking-distance comparisons with stock timing. Linux was checked only under WSL2; the AppImage is untested on native Linux and Steam Deck. These are author measurements, not equivalence checks; this collection did not run them.

GitHub detects no license and the reviewed tree has no LICENSE file, so reuse terms for the project’s own code are not stated; the pinned psxrecomp fork carries the PolyForm Noncommercial 1.0.0 license. The game and its trademarks remain with Fox Interactive, Activision and the other named owners. README discloses that the port was made almost entirely with Claude Code under the owner’s direction; no REA use is stated.

name: OpenRCT2: an open re-implementation of RollerCoaster Tycoon 2
description_en: Re-implements RollerCoaster Tycoon 2, originally written in x86 assembly, as a C++ engine that runs on the original game’s data. It loads RCT2 saves and scenarios, and RCT1 scenarios when those files are present, while saving to its own documented park format. Modern-platform support, interface and AI changes, higher limits and multiplayer are deliberate extensions, not reproductions of the original.
description_zh: 以 C++ 引擎重新实现原本用 x86 汇编编写的 RollerCoaster Tycoon 2，并在原游戏数据上运行。它可载入 RCT2 存档和场景，具备相应文件时也能载入 RCT1 场景，而保存时使用自己有文档说明的乐园格式。现代平台支持、界面与 AI 改动、更高上限和多人游戏都是有意扩展，并非对原版的复现。
requirements: The reviewed develop snapshot follows the v0.5.6 release of 2026-10-10. The README says OpenRCT2 attempts to provide everything from RCT2 plus many improvements, and restores some RollerCoaster Tycoon mechanics, so intentional differences are part of the design. The reviewed files do not document how the original game was analysed, and no original source is recovered.

Playing requires the user’s own RollerCoaster Tycoon 2 files; the README names Steam and GOG.com editions. Original RollerCoaster Tycoon files are optional and enable its scenarios. By default, installation downloads OpenRCT2’s own objects, title sequences, OpenSoundEffects and OpenMusic packs, and test builds also fetch replays, each pinned by SHA-256.

Source builds use CMake 3.24+ and a C++20 compiler, with wiki guides for Linux, macOS, Windows, WSL and MSYS2 MinGW and an option to force 32-bit builds. Portable builds, installers, a launcher and several Linux and BSD packages are listed for players.

CI checks formatting, builds on several platforms and runs the GoogleTest suite, including replay, RCT2 save import/export, ride-rating, pathfinding and scenario-decryption tests on project test data. These guard OpenRCT2’s own behaviour and file compatibility, not equivalence with the RCT2 executable; this review ran none of them.
licence.txt applies GPL-3.0-or-later to OpenRCT2; original game data and purchased editions keep their own rights. The reviewed sources establish no REA or AI use.

name: Touhou 6: reconstructing Embodiment of Scarlet Devil 1.02h source
description_en: Reconstructs C++ source for the Windows executable of Touhou 6: Embodiment of Scarlet Devil version 1.02h, aiming at an exact rebuild with the original Visual Studio .NET 2002 and DirectX 8 toolchain. reccmp and objdiff compare the rebuilt binary with the user’s original executable function by function. The committed progress badge reports every function implemented but 98.03% byte accuracy, so whole-binary identity is not claimed.
description_zh: 为 Touhou 6：东方红魔乡 1.02h 版的 Windows 可执行文件重建 C++ 源码，目标是用原版 Visual Studio .NET 2002 与 DirectX 8 工具链精确重新构建。reccmp 和 objdiff 将重建的二进制与使用者自备的原可执行文件逐函数比较。仓库内的进度徽章报告函数已全部实现、字节准确率为 98.03%，因此不主张整个二进制完全一致。
requirements: README states the aim of perfectly reconstructing the 1.02h source; the committed, mutable progress badge reports 100.0% implemented and 98.03% byte accuracy for TH06.EXE. README points to a separate portable branch for Linux and modern Windows, which is not covered here. The team’s Ghidra work is exported as XML to the companion happyhavoc/th06-re repository.

Supply your own original 東方紅魔郷.exe version 1.02h matching the SHA-256 in README, copied to resources/th06.exe; reccmp checks the same hash, and the build extracts the game icon from that file. The repository contains no game executable or data; the comparison workflow fetches the original binary from a secret-configured URL.

Builds need Python 3.4+, plus msiextract and Wine outside Windows (CrossOver is suggested on macOS); aria2c is optional. scripts/create_devenv.py downloads Visual Studio .NET 2002 and the DirectX 8.0 SDK from web archives, along with ninja, objdiff, Ghidra and helper tools, and scripts/build.py generates and runs a ninja build.

Contributors diff with reccmp, which reports per-function accuracy of the rebuilt executable against the original as an HTML report. CI builds on Windows and compares an objdiff build with objects delinked from the original through Ghidra; a small munit suite reads the user’s game archive. Badge figures are project-generated, and this collection did not build or compare anything.

The repository is dedicated under CC0 1.0; the original game, the downloaded Microsoft toolchain and third-party tools keep their own terms. The reviewed sources establish no AI or REA attribution, and no runtime reproduction is claimed.

name: BINNY
description_en: An open-source terminal agent harness from OpenBin that runs a user-chosen hosted or local model over binary-analysis data. It reads decompiled functions, strings, imports and data from an OpenBin or OpenAPK project or a local Ghidra container run, follows triage, investigation and drafting playbooks, and saves a draft malware-analysis or vulnerability-research report for human review. It is an analysis harness with draft outputs, not a reconstruction project.
description_zh: OpenBin 推出的开源终端智能体框架，让使用者自选的托管或本地模型处理二进制分析数据。它从 OpenBin 或 OpenAPK 项目、或本地 Ghidra 容器的分析结果中读取反编译函数、字符串、导入表和数据，按分诊、调查与起草流程工作，并保存恶意软件分析或漏洞研究报告草稿供人工审阅。它是输出草稿的分析框架，而非重建项目。
requirements: The reviewed pin follows the v0.1.0-beta.2 release of 2026-10-15. BINNY is a Go terminal program; release builds use Go 1.22 and cover Linux, macOS and Windows, and the README installers fetch scripts from openbin.ai. Startup needs an OpenBin sign-in: main.go loads the openbin CLI’s stored credentials and stops with an instruction to run openbin login when none exist. Source comments describe planned paid access whose gating is deferred during testing.

Models are bring-your-own-key, with Anthropic, OpenAI, DeepSeek, Qwen, Kimi, Gemini through an OpenAI-compatible endpoint and Bedrock preconfigured; Ollama or LM Studio models must support tool calling and need a larger context window than Ollama’s 4k default. Analysis data comes from the user’s OpenBin or OpenAPK projects or a local file. Local decompilation and the sandbox need Docker, and the first local decompile downloads an OpenBin Ghidra worker image of about 700 MB.

The sandbox tool runs scripts in a container with no network, a read-only root and sample mount, dropped capabilities and CPU, memory and process limits. Triage labels samples with the STIX 2.1 malware vocabulary, malware and vulnerability modes change the report lens, and autonomous, supervised or collaborative modes decide when the agent stops to ask. The README treats existing reports as claims to check and saves drafts for review before publication.

The repository has Go unit tests, which the release workflow runs before cross-compiling; it publishes no benchmark, accuracy measurement or worked example report, so analysis quality is not established here. Its README still calls the source repository private while it is public. This collection reviewed source and documentation without running BINNY, models, containers or samples.

LICENSE is AGPL-3.0; the README states AGPL-3.0 or later. Contributors sign a CLA so OpenBin can also offer the code under a commercial licence, and the README says the OpenBin platform it talks to uses the same licence. Model services, OpenBin accounts, Ghidra and analysed samples carry their own terms. The reviewed sources establish no REA connection.

name: RKD Telemetry Extractor: decoding Race-Keeper track-day recordings
description_en: Documents the proprietary .rkd telemetry format written by Race-Keeper “Instant Video” recorders, whose bundled player runs only on Windows, and implements matching Python and Go parsers that export GPS and IMU channels as Telemetry Overlay CSV and GPX. The author credits Claude Code with the hex-dump analysis and hypothesis testing, anchored by known car IDs, circuit location and speeds. Field meanings rest on physical cross-checks from the author’s own recordings, and several record types remain partly unknown.
description_zh: 记录 Race-Keeper “Instant Video” 记录仪所写的专有 .rkd 遥测格式（随附播放器仅支持 Windows），并以结果一致的 Python 与 Go 解析器把 GPS 和 IMU 通道导出为 Telemetry Overlay CSV 与 GPX。作者称十六进制分析和假设检验由 Claude Code 协助完成，并以已知车辆编号、赛道位置和车速作为锚点。字段含义依据作者自有录制数据的物理交叉核对得出，若干记录类型仍未完全解读。
requirements: The reviewed pin is Python package version 1.0.0 from February 2026. It decodes the 8-byte signature, meta header, 10-byte record headers and the configuration, GPS, accelerometer, gyroscope, periodic, timestamp and terminator records, then exports 30 Hz Telemetry Overlay CSV, roughly 5 Hz GPX and a session summary. It reads telemetry only; the .mp4 video is used as is, and OBD-II channels are unsupported because the source recordings had no scanner connected.

Users supply .rkd files from their own Race-Keeper recordings. The repository includes a truncated sample of about 50 GPS fixes from the author’s 2021 session with reference CSV and GPX output, but not the vendor player, the USB-stick contents or full recordings. Python 3.9+ and the Go toolchain use only standard libraries; README says Go 1.21+, while go.mod declares go 1.24.7.

Research notes and a session log attribute the analysis to Claude Code (claude-opus-4-6) across three February 2026 sessions plus a fourth for tests, documentation and the Go port. The README and notes give about four hours, while the log’s per-session durations total more. The JSONL transcripts are described but not published, so the dialogue cannot be checked from the repository.

Reported validation compares recorded speed with haversine-derived speed (under 1% error), checks mean vertical acceleration against 1 g, fits a gyroscope divisor of about 28 against GPS heading changes and matches altitude to circuit topography. The CRC polynomial, periodic and timer fields, two terminator fields and the exact gyroscope calibration remain unknown or empirical. CI runs Python 3.9, 3.11 and 3.13 tests with a 100% branch-coverage gate, and Go tests on Ubuntu and macOS that compare Go output with the committed Python reference CSV and GPX; this collection ran neither suite.

The project declares MIT and states that it is independent of and not endorsed by Race-Keeper or Trivinci Systems LLC. Decoding is limited to the hardware revision and recordings the author examined, and other devices or firmware versions may differ. The reviewed sources establish no REA use.

name: pwndbg
description_en: Python plug-in that loads into GDB, or runs as a REPL around LLDB, to make live program state easier to inspect. Each stop prints a context of registers, stack, call frames and annotated disassembly with recursively dereferenced pointers; commands cover memory maps, search, telescoping, heap allocators and Go values, with Capstone/Unicorn emulation and decompiler integration for IDA, Binary Ninja, Ghidra and angr-management. The README lists Linux ELF, macOS Mach-O, QEMU user/system and embedded Cortex-M or RISC-V/32 debugging.
description_zh: 可加载到 GDB 中、或作为 LLDB 外层 REPL 运行的 Python 插件，使运行中程序的状态更易检查。每次停下时都会打印寄存器、栈、调用帧和带注释的反汇编等上下文，并递归解引用指针；命令涵盖内存映射、搜索、内存链式查看、堆分配器和 Go 值，还借助 Capstone/Unicorn 模拟执行指令，并可与 IDA、Binary Ninja、Ghidra 和 angr-management 反编译器集成。README 列出 Linux ELF、macOS Mach-O、QEMU 用户态／系统态以及嵌入式 Cortex-M 或 RISC-V/32 调试场景。
requirements: Compatibility table: pwndbg-gdb needs Python 3.10+ and GDB 12.1+ (tested on Ubuntu 22.04/24.04); pwndbg-lldb needs Python 3.12+ and LLDB 19+, and its support is marked experimental/early-stage; qemu-user needs QEMU 8.1+ (its vFile API is needed for vmmap) and qemu-system QEMU 6.2+. Mach-O debugging on macOS uses LLDB, and qemu-user debugging is GDB only.

Release at review: 2026.09.15, published 2026-09-20, with portable archives, deb/rpm/apk/Arch packages, including macOS portable builds; the setup guide covers Linux and macOS through an install script, Homebrew, Nix, distro packages and source installs. The reviewed dev commit declares the same version.
MIT license. Decompiler integration needs the separately installed decompiler. No debugging sessions were run.

name: Driver Recompiled: a psxrecomp setup host that builds the game locally
description_en: Packages a psxrecomp static-recompilation project for Driver (PlayStation, USA) as a setup host: releases carry the recompiler, runtime and a recomp-ui launcher, and the player’s machine generates and compiles the game from the user’s own disc image. The repository holds configuration, Ghidra-derived function seeds and release automation rather than game code. Its documented status is thin: an operator-confirmed private build reaches gameplay, while package release gates remain open.
description_zh: 将 Driver（PlayStation 美版）的 psxrecomp 静态重编译项目打包为“安装宿主”：发布包含重编译器、运行时和 recomp-ui 启动器，再由玩家电脑依据使用者自备的光盘镜像生成并编译游戏。仓库只包含配置、来自 Ghidra 的函数种子和发布自动化脚本，不含游戏代码。文档记录的状态较为有限：维护者确认一个私有构建可以进入游戏，而发布包的验收门槛仍未完成。
requirements: The reviewed main branch (VERSION 0.3.6) targets only the USA release SLUS-00842 and pins Alexbeav’s psxrecomp fork at 08ec704a and recomp-ui at be8ac1d0. FEASIBILITY.md records the status bootstrap_verified: the operator confirmed that a private promoted build reaches gameplay. No mode or feature coverage is documented, and the README notes that public v0.3.0 can relaunch the wrong executable after its first build.

The player supplies an owned disc image of Driver (USA, SLUS-00842); game.toml records the expected data-track size and hashes. Release CI packages a setup host without game C, BIOS backends, disc images or a prebuilt playable executable. The workflow says users generate OpenBIOS, with a retail BIOS optional, while FEASIBILITY.md mentions the player supplying a BIOS; generated code and the executable stay on the user’s machine.

v0.3.6 publishes packages for Windows x64, Linux x64, macOS Apple Silicon and macOS Intel, but the documentation keeps each platform claim pending exact-package setup, startup and clean-exit gates; the README describes 0.3.0 as Windows x64 only. Local builds use the psxrecomp CLI, CMake, Ninja, Python and C/C++ toolchains, with Windows on the framework’s portable toolchain route.

Reported checks are setup executable-name and source-parity tests and YAML and release-workflow audits. The README also describes boot gates and A/B comparisons against Beetle and DuckStation across the author’s ports, but the reviewed tree publishes no comparison results for this title. These are project reports; this collection ran nothing.

Project-owned files are GPL-3.0-only; psxrecomp keeps PolyForm Noncommercial 1.0.0 and recomp-ui MIT, and the GPL does not cover retail content or generated retail code. The README says the ports are developed with substantial AI assistance, with AI writing most of the code; no REA use is stated.

name: Himuro: a matching Fatal Frame PS2 decompilation
description_en: Reconstructs Fatal Frame’s PS2 executable as C for the US, EU and Japanese releases, built with the original EE-GCC 2.9 toolchain and checked by SHA-1 against the user’s own executables. Committed objdiff reports list the US and EU code as fully matched and the Japanese code as partial, and a few routines still rely on assembly or byte patches. Porting to modern hardware is a stated later goal, not part of this repository.
description_zh: 将 Fatal Frame（《零》）PS2 可执行文件的美版、欧版和日版重建为 C，使用原始的 EE-GCC 2.9 工具链构建，并以使用者自备可执行文件的 SHA-1 校验结果。仓库提交的 objdiff 报告显示美版和欧版代码已全部匹配、日版仅部分匹配，少数例程仍依赖汇编或字节补丁。移植到现代硬件是项目声明的后续目标，不在本仓库范围内。
requirements: Covers SLUS_203.88 (US), SLES_508.21 (EU) and SLPS_250.74 (JP); the output is a rebuilt PS2 ELF, not a PC port, which the README names only as a later goal. After the project’s own report-adjustment script, the committed objdiff reports list 3,437 of 3,437 US and 3,464 of 3,464 EU functions with all code and data matched, but 2,712 of 3,394 JP functions (73.64% of code). The README’s decomp.dev badges are mutable.

Copy the matching main executable from your own disc or ISO into config/<region>/; the README gives the required SHA-1 for each region. Data extraction, splitting and the expected assembly are generated locally, and no game assets are committed.

Linux is required: Python 3.8+ in a virtual environment, make, i386 libc/libstdc++ for the committed 32-bit EE-GCC 2.9-991111-01 compiler, and the decompals PS2 binutils v0.10 installed separately; objdiff-cli is also committed. Each region is extracted, configured and built separately.

The ninja build runs sha1sum against config/<region>/checksum.sha1, so a successful build reproduces the supplied executable. To reach that hash, the build rewrites selected compiler output from asm_patches.json and copies listed byte ranges from the original executable into the built file (PhotoScoreCount in US and EU, DspSpData in EU). CI only uploads the committed reports and cannot build without the executables; this collection did not rerun anything.

MIT license for the project; Fatal Frame and its executables retain separate rights, and the committed compiler binaries keep their own terms. The reviewed sources establish no AI or REA attribution, and the archive link in the reported X post was not used as evidence.

name: DOAXVB Native PC Port: statically recompiling Dead or Alive Xtreme Beach Volleyball
description_en: Lifts the original Xbox executable of Dead or Alive Xtreme Beach Volleyball to C with a fork of xboxrecomp and links it with a hand-written runtime that replaces kernel imports, audio and key Direct3D 8 and DirectSound APIs. Setup builds the runner locally from the user’s USA disc image and checks generated files against hashes in an authenticated recipe; releases carry only tools and source. Rewriting game logic as readable source has so far reached only the startup thread entry.
description_zh: 借助 xboxrecomp 的分支将原版 Xbox《Dead or Alive Xtreme Beach Volleyball》可执行文件提升为 C 代码，并与手写运行时链接，由运行时替代内核导入、音频以及关键的 Direct3D 8 和 DirectSound API。安装程序依据使用者自有的美版光盘镜像在本地构建运行程序，并按经认证配方中的哈希校验生成文件；发布包只含工具和源码。将游戏逻辑改写为可读源码的工作目前只完成了启动线程入口。
requirements: The README calls the port fully playable as of 0.4 Beta: long player sessions covered every stage, the Casino, Hotel and Shops, saving and reloading, and a vacation’s end, the last starting from an edited save. Lighting, camera and full rendering fidelity remain incomplete, three known issues are open, and the 0.6.0 RC1 prerelease has had only macOS and Steam Deck smoke runs. Hand-written game logic covers only the startup thread entry.

Requires the user’s own USA Xbox disc image; setup extracts it, checks the XBE and stops if any recipe input or generated file differs from the recorded hashes. Generated game C, extracted files, saves and run evidence stay in an ignored private folder, and NOTICE states that the repository distributes no game, generated game code, assets or console firmware.

Windows release setup bundles Python, Capstone, Git, CMake and extract-xiso and downloads a pinned llvm-mingw clang release. macOS and Linux/SteamOS builds need CMake, Ninja, SDL3, Python with Capstone 5.0.9 and a self-built extract-xiso, with Vulkan through SDL3 and shaderc on Linux. The lifter is a pinned branch of NoRain211’s fork of sp00nznet/xboxrecomp.

Public CI checks the recipe, setup and ISO-extraction scripts with synthetic inputs and builds and runs the runtime tests on Windows without game files. The status page states that these tests do not show the game boots or plays; playability rests on owner and contributor sessions, and PlayStation pads are unconfirmed on hardware. This collection did not build or run the port.

Original code is GPL-3.0-or-later, and NOTICE grants no rights to the game; xboxrecomp is MIT and other components keep their own licenses. The README and NOTICE state substantial use of LLMs and AI coding agents for code, reverse-engineering analysis, debugging, tests and documentation, with changes reviewed and tested; no REA use is stated.

name: Elgato HDR: a userspace capture path for the Elgato 4K X’s 10-bit mode
description_en: A native macOS app that reaches the Elgato 4K X capture card’s 10-bit P010 video mode, which the project says Apple’s built-in webcam driver does not expose to apps. A root helper detaches that driver and runs the card’s USB Video Class streaming directly through libusb, feeding a Metal HDR viewer, an HDR10 recorder and an editor. Latency figures and device coverage remain author-reported.
description_zh: 一款原生 macOS 应用，用于获取 Elgato 4K X 采集卡的 10 位 P010 视频模式；项目称苹果内置的摄像头驱动不会向应用开放该模式。一个 root 权限辅助程序卸下该驱动，通过 libusb 直接执行采集卡的 USB 视频类（UVC）串流，为 Metal HDR 预览、HDR10 录制和编辑器提供画面。延迟数据和设备覆盖范围仍为作者报告。
requirements: Reviewed at the 2026-10-13 head, after release 1.0.0 (2026-09-08). It targets an Elgato 4K X on macOS 14 or newer; the README reports building and testing on Apple Silicon only, and other Elgato cards with a P010 UVC format are untested. The HDR preview needs an HDR/EDR display. Among the 10-bit modes, 4K is limited to 30 fps by USB bandwidth.

Building needs Xcode Command Line Tools and Homebrew’s libusb: build.sh compiles the C helper against libusb, bundles the library, compiles the Swift app and signs it ad hoc, and releases are not notarized. The helper needs one administrator prompt because detaching the macOS kernel driver requires root; it exits about 20 seconds after the app quits and hands the card back to macOS.

The repository keeps the USB descriptor-dump tools used while reverse-engineering the card and a script that sweeps every capture mode; it contains no vendor firmware or driver binaries. Recordings carry fixed HDR10 mastering metadata because, per the README, the card does not pass the source’s HDMI HDR metadata over USB.

The README and the Game-mode pull request report display delays of about 48, 22 and 5 ms for the Smooth, Game and Lowest Latency modes at 1440p60 on a 120 Hz MacBook Pro, measured from USB transfer completion to display as reported by macOS; the card’s own processing comes on top, and the PR notes that the test card sent silent audio. These are author measurements and were not reproduced here.

MIT covers the project code; the bundled libusb library and captured content keep their own terms, and the project states it is not affiliated with Elgato or Corsair. An X post under the same handle credits REA with helping this latency work, but the repository does not mention REA, so REA use is unconfirmed.

name: ido-static-recomp
description_en: Statically recompiles the IRIX MIPS programs of SGI's IDO 5.3 and 7.1 C toolchain, such as cc, cfe, uopt, ugen and as1, into native Linux, macOS and Windows executables, so matching decompilation projects can build with the original compiler code on modern hosts. It recompiles compilers, not games: it neither decompiles nor translates game code.
description_zh: 将 SGI IDO 5.3 与 7.1 C 工具链中的 IRIX MIPS 程序（如 cc、cfe、uopt、ugen 和 as1）静态重编译为原生 Linux、macOS 和 Windows 可执行文件，使匹配式反编译项目能在现代主机上以原始编译器代码进行构建。它重编译的是编译器而非游戏，本身既不反编译也不转换游戏代码。
requirements: Building needs make and a C11/C++17 compiler (build-essential on Debian/Ubuntu, Homebrew make on macOS). make setup builds the vendored rabbitizer disassembler and the recompiler; make VERSION=5.3 or VERSION=7.1 then emits the toolchain under build/<version>/out, with RELEASE=1 for optimized builds and TARGET=universal for universal macOS binaries. Release v1.2 (2024-11-12) ships IDO 5.3 and 7.1 archives for Linux, Linux ARM, macOS and Windows; the reviewed main commit dates from 2025-07-05.

Recompiled programs expect a flattened directory beside cc, with USR_LIB and USR_INCLUDE environment overrides for the /usr/lib and /usr/include redirection. The IDO 5.3 program list includes copt, ld and strip, which the 7.1 list lacks.

Perfect Dark pins github.com/Emill/ido-static-recomp at 421e546 (per-function branch, 2021-11-03) as its tools/recomp submodule. GitHub compares that commit with this entry's pin as diverged, 87 commits ahead and 2 behind, and Emill is among the decompals contributors; neither repository is marked as a fork, and the Perfect Dark entry keeps its own pin. Other matching decompilations, such as Majora's Mask, download builds from decompals.

The repository bundles the original IRIX compiler binaries under ido/5.3 and ido/7.1. Only ido/5.3 carries an SGI freeware notice; no license file covers the recompiler or the IDO 7.1 binaries at the reviewed commit, GitHub detects no repository license, and the vendored rabbitizer keeps its own MIT license. No license is asserted here, and no toolchain was built or run.

name: TH08 Web: a WebAssembly port built from reconstructed source
description_en: Compiles the reconstructed C++ source of the Japanese Touhou 8 1.00d release to WebAssembly with Emscripten, adding WebGL 2 rendering, Web Audio, browser input and IndexedDB saves behind the game’s D3D8-, DirectSound- and DirectInput-shaped interfaces. Players select their own retail DAT files locally. The web build makes no binary-exact claim and is a separate port from the curated TH08 reconstruction.
description_zh: 使用 Emscripten 将日版 Touhou 8 1.00d 的重建 C++ 源码编译为 WebAssembly，并在游戏原有的 D3D8、DirectSound 与 DirectInput 形态接口之后接入 WebGL 2 渲染、Web Audio、浏览器输入和 IndexedDB 存档。玩家在本地选择自备的正版 DAT 文件。网页构建不主张与原二进制逐字节一致，是独立于已收录 TH08 重建的移植。
requirements: README reports the game playable from title to ending in desktop browsers and recommends current Chrome; Firefox automatically uses a dedicated no-readback build, while Safari and mobile browsers are not verified. The page needs WebAssembly threads, SharedArrayBuffer, WebGL 2, Web Audio and cross-origin-isolated HTTPS. Listed remaining work includes Firefox hardware profiling, replay endurance and memory-ceiling measurement.

Select th08.dat and thbgm.dat from your own legally obtained TH08 installation. The launcher copies th08.dat into session memory and range-reads thbgm.dat; README says neither is uploaded, bundled or persisted. The repository, deployment and release v0.1.0 contain no retail data or executable, and a provenance script rejects forbidden payloads and any artifact outside the nine-file allowlist.

Local builds need Docker, Python 3 and a desktop browser: scripts/build-web-game.sh uses a digest-pinned Emscripten 6.0.8 image, and scripts/serve-web.py supplies the COOP, COEP and CORP headers a generic static server lacks.
